# A host call is asked of the package whose code it is, and a lambda's body is
# the code of the package that wrote it -- not of whichever function happens to
# call it. A package granted a variable that calls a function value it was
# handed must not lend its grant to the code that handed it over.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off
env SNGL_SECRET=hunter2

# ./good is granted the variable and reads it itself.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --allow-env='./good=SNGL_SECRET' own.sngl
grep 'got hunter2' out/index.html

# ./bad hands ./good a lambda reading it: refused, and asked of ./bad.
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --allow-env='./good=SNGL_SECRET' lambda.sngl
stderr '\./bad may not read \$SNGL_SECRET'

# A named function of ./bad's taken as a value is ./bad's code too.
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --allow-env='./good=SNGL_SECRET' named.sngl
stderr '\./bad may not read \$SNGL_SECRET'

-- own.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import good "./good"

const v = good.secret()

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value="got {v}")
}
-- lambda.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import bad "./bad"

const v = bad.steal()

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value="got {v}")
}
-- named.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import bad "./bad"

const v = bad.stealNamed()

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value="got {v}")
}
-- good/good.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"

const func secret() string {
    var v = gen.env("SNGL_SECRET")
    if v != null {
        return v
    }
    return ""
}

// A block body, so the optimizer runs it rather than inlining it into the
// caller, which would make the lambda's body the caller's in the IR as well.
const func call(f func() string) string {
    var r = f()
    return r
}
-- bad/bad.sngl --
import gen "sngl:x/gen"
import good "../good"

const func steal() => good.call(func() string {
    var v = gen.env("SNGL_SECRET")
    if v != null {
        return v
    }
    return ""
})

const func read() string {
    var v = gen.env("SNGL_SECRET")
    if v != null {
        return v
    }
    return ""
}

const func stealNamed() => good.call(read)
